description: This file defines a Go package 'model' that implements schema-related interfaces and classes for handling JSON schema validation, particularly for Kubernetes API extensions. It includes structural schema representations, validation rules, and conversion functions.

classes.name: Structural
classes.description: Represents a structural JSON schema with various validation and structural properties.

classes.name: StructuralOrBool
classes.description: Wraps a schema.Structural or a boolean to represent additional schema options.

classes.name: StructuralValidationRule
classes.description: Defines a validation rule with associated message and field path.

methods.name: Schema
methods.description: Returns the schema as a common.Schema interface.

methods.name: Allows
methods.description: Indicates if the schema allows the boolean value.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type of the schema.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Returns the format of the schema if specified.

methods.name: Pattern
methods.description: Returns the pattern string if specified.

methods.name: Items
methods.description: Returns the schema for items if applicable.

methods.name: Properties
methods.description: Returns a map of property names to schemas.

methods.name: AdditionalProperties
methods.description: Returns additional properties schema or boolean.

methods.name: Default
methods.description: Returns the default value for the schema.

methods.name: IsExclusiveMinimum
methods.description: Checks if the minimum is exclusive.

methods.name: IsExclusiveMaximum
methods.description: Checks if the maximum is exclusive.

methods.name: Required
methods.description: Returns the list of required fields.

methods.name: UniqueItems
methods.description: Indicates if items are unique (always false in this implementation).

methods.name: Nullable
methods.description: Indicates if the schema is nullable.

methods.name: IsXPreserveUnknownFields
methods.description: Checks if schema preserves unknown fields.

methods.name: nestedValueValidationToStructural
methods.description: Converts nested value validation to Structural schema.

methods.name: WithTypeAndObjectMeta
methods.description: Returns schema with type and object metadata.
